description: [$0.01 USDC per call via x402] Halal places in a named city (geocoded), e.g. city=Houston, TX. Up to 50 results sorted by distance from the city centre, optional cuisine filter. OpenStreetMap data (ODbL).

city.description: City name, optionally with region/country, e.g. 'Houston, TX' or 'Birmingham, UK'

radius_km.description: Radius from city centre in km, 1-30 (default 15)
